name: AHDTrusteeInvitationComplete
title: Trusted person invitation acceptance ($complete)
description: UC-AHD-060: the invitation recipient accepts the trusted person invitation with a digitally signed RelatedPerson (ASiC-E container). Under the stage-1 configuration the operation stores the container locally and returns the references below. Where digital signing is not enabled the operation responds with HTTP 501.

parameter.name: signedBinary
parameter.documentation: Digitally signed trusted person (ASiC-E container) as a Binary resource.

parameter.name: task
parameter.documentation: Reference to the completed invitation (Task) version.

parameter.name: relatedPerson
parameter.documentation: Reference to the confirmed trusted person (RelatedPerson) version.

parameter.name: provenance
parameter.documentation: Reference to the stored signing Provenance.

parameter.name: signedBinary
parameter.documentation: Reference to the stored signed Binary.
